readiness.summary: This app needs changes before Deployz can deploy it.

findings.title: Needs a graphics processor (GPU)
findings.whyItMatters: Deployz provisions one container per application with managed database, cache, and storage. Extra infrastructure the app expects would not exist at runtime.
findings.suggestedOutcome: Use a processor-only configuration, or move the graphics processing to a service that provides it.
findings.technicalEvidence: Unsupported infrastructure: the app requires a GPU (docker/Dockerfile). Deployz runs CPU-only containers.
findings.plainEnglishExplanation: This app requires a graphics processor to run. Deployz runs apps on standard processors only.

findings.title: Tell Deployz which port your app listens on
findings.whyItMatters: Deployz routes customer traffic and health checks to one port. Without it, the app would run but never receive requests.
findings.suggestedOutcome: Declare the port the app listens on (for example an EXPOSE instruction in the Dockerfile), or set it in the application details.
findings.technicalEvidence: No port was found in the Dockerfile (EXPOSE or ENV PORT), an env file, a compose file, or a process.env.PORT default in source.
findings.plainEnglishExplanation: Deployz could not find the network port this app listens on.

findings.title: Give Deployz a way to check your app
findings.whyItMatters: During every deployment, Deployz waits for your app to report healthy before sending traffic to it. Without a health signal, a broken deploy cannot be detected or rolled back.
findings.suggestedOutcome: Expose a lightweight route (for example /health) that returns success once the app is ready, and reference it from the container health check.
findings.technicalEvidence: No health endpoint or container health check was found (no /health-style route, no HEALTHCHECK instruction).
findings.plainEnglishExplanation: Deployz needs a reliable way to know when your app is running and ready.

unsupportedReasons: Unsupported infrastructure: the app requires a GPU (docker/Dockerfile). Deployz runs CPU-only containers.
